scope: Simplify the invitation email and match the existing CaseLink website design
subject: You've been invited to CaseLink

checks: Public Settings sends a native invitation to the delivery simulator
Configured mail service retains the accepted test email
Sent email uses the simplified CaseLink invitation and one acceptance button
Accepted template uses the canonical confirmation page and fragment-only token
The actual emailed link completes password setup and fresh sign-in

normalReview: Preserved the exact canonical fragment-only invitation URL, deliberate confirmation, one-use behavior and 900-second provider expiry. Only invitation content and subject changed. Verified accessibility and mobile/desktop layout, then inspected a native sent email and completed its password setup/sign-in with a disposable account.
ponytailReview: Removed explanatory paragraphs, duplicate raw link, nested callout, old CL badge and teal styling. Reused the website palette and serif hierarchy with email-safe font fallbacks. No dependencies, remote font/image requests, tracking, schema changes or web release needed.

retainedFirstAttempt.note: The first test email still used the prior cached provider template; a fresh invitation after propagation passed all five checks.

limits: Browser previews and a provider-simulator email do not establish identical rendering in every email app.
Human inbox placement was not retested.
